products.mode: default marine forecast/current state; not historical/single-run; timezone UTC; timeformat omitted ISO8601 default
products.modelSelection: BEST_MATCH automatic; current public provider branch includes mfsst. Neither geographic SST switching nor all-wave-model mixing established. New runs may replace same-valid-time content; deployment/source changes possible but actual occurrence not demonstrated.
products.responseProvenance: NO_EXACT_RESPONSE_RUN_BINDING_ESTABLISHED; no environmental response acquired. Documented response schema lacks exact model/run/initialization/revision fields; actual Pelora parser retains none even if injected. generationtime_ms is computation duration, not run creation/receipt.
products.retained: requested/resolved coordinates, Celsius/Fahrenheit, observedAt, Open-Meteo forecast-model classification; no model, product release, run, interval, or support fields

historicalIdentity.sameContentDifferentRuns: Synthetic parser outputs and exact captures identical when omitted run/model metadata alone differs
historicalIdentity.changedContentSameTime: Different normalized values generate different scientificContentDigest/capture references; not an exact-content identity collision. Neither digest attributes the upstream run.
historicalIdentity.primitive: ProductVersion and lineage identity can distinguish supplied authority, but cannot invent omitted provider facts

products.consumerRequirement: All10 active direct/transitive SST bindings PROVENANCE_REQUIREMENT_UNRESOLVED. No existing requirement selects exact-run vs stable-family vs value/time-only. No request change or exact-model-selection mandate justified.
products.metadata: REFERENCE_METADATA_REQUIRED if exact run attribution is required; consumer authority first determines minimum. No successor demonstrated.
products.legacy: Preserve exact as-used normalized content; missing upstream run cannot be reconstructed from validTime/current latest-model metadata.

products.timeRetained: ERDDAP row time -> observedAt; nominal coordinate only for exact bounds purpose
products.deterministicReconstruction: NOT_ESTABLISHED; noon +/-12h, filename date, collection coverage and daily cadence rejected as unauthorised inference
products.futureMetadata: Content-bound authoritative bounds or versioned product rule/reference; reference-vs-capture implementation not selected
products.compatibility: All11 DIRECT direct/transitive bindings PRODUCT_SUPPORT_UNRESOLVED; existing timestamp-oriented consumers do not prove composite acceptance.
products.legacy: LEGACY_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT from retained fields alone; do not rewrite

products.producer: NOAA ocean-color science team; CoastWatch conversion/distribution; Pelora does not execute DINEOF
products.algorithm: DINEOF; exact deployed version unavailable; input MSL12v1.3 not reconstruction release
products.target: Daily target image/state described; exact UTC bounds/nominal coordinate anchor remain unqualified
products.otherInputs: Monthly climatology; its vintage/support must remain separate from trailing daily inputs
products.weighting: EOF spatio-temporal reconstruction, not a documented fixed linear temporal weighting; per-output weights/deployment settings not retained
products.lookahead: No claim of later-target daily inputs for the described operational workflow. Target content still produced/received later; exact pre-assessment receipt remains independently required. Unversioned reconstructions cannot be assumed causal solely from a nominal label.
provenanceRequirements: input observation identities/support and window or immutable rule binding
products.revision: Changed inputs, delayed replacements, processing/config changes can alter reconstruction; no actual revision occurrence or preference established. Same target is not exact content identity.
products.metadata: INSUFFICIENT for exact target/deployed lineage; existing content/reference structures can distinguish supplied identity without proving missing authority
products.compatibility: All11 GAP_FILLED direct/transitive bindings PRODUCT_SUPPORT_UNRESOLVED; no DIRECT equivalence or composite/reconstructed acceptance inferred from timestamp-based code.
products.legacy: LEGACY_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT; documented procedure not retroactive per-content proof

sources.finding: Default Best Match; explicit model selection optional. General location-dependent model choice does not prove geography-dependent SST switching. Locked instant-state meaning not requalified.

models optional, timeformat defaults iso8601; response documents coordinates, generationtime_ms, timezone and weather values, not per-value run/revision authority. Schema alone is not a captured response.
marine route defaults marine_best_match; branch includes mfsst. Public main is not exact deployment evidence. No automatic geographic SST-model switching is established by the wave-reader list.

Initialization, modification and API-availability timestamps differ; metadata describes latest model updates, not exact past response/run binding. Multiple-server update timing cautions prevent a separate latest metadata fetch proving lineage.
Exact NRT S-NPP daily L3 title; processing_level L2 discrepancy; time bounds names baseline_bounds but values are not exposed. Global coverage spans collection.
Daily global mapped single-file L3 4km identified separately from L2 swaths; linked metadata/ATBD do not establish exact UTC composite endpoints.
Section1.2 scopes SDR-to-EDR processing. No exact active L3 UTC composite-day rule located. PAR24-hour definition is not chlorophyll support authority.
UTC start in L2 science-quality filename is not an exact NRT L3 bounds rule; rejected substitution.
Exact two-sensor NRT DINEOF dataset; processing version unspecified. Target coordinate and cell-method label do not expose exact target bounds or input revision list.
NOAA science producer, CoastWatch conversion; merged daily inputs plus monthly climatology; links EOS operational description; MSL12 input version not deployed DINEOF version.

2019 operational description specifies target day plus previous29 daily merged SNPP/NOAA20 images. Establishes documented trailing30day NRT configuration, not exact UTC cell endpoints or every current revision deployment.
Study uses30day block; not substituted for operational target alignment. Temporal/spatial coherency and EOF reconstruction are not fixed interpolation weights.
Routine processing30daily inputs and climatology fallback corroborate multi-time dependence; no immutable per-content deployment/window binding.

questions.question: For this default /v1/marine current=sea_surface_temperature request, what response-bound identifier proves exact upstream SST dataset/release and run/initialization? Is mfsst the sole source across supported locations and dates, and how are source/deployment changes distinguished? A separately fetched latest-model status is not sufficient.

For each of the10 SST-dependent active consumers, is exact upstream run needed, stable product-family identity sufficient, or exact normalized value/valid time plus governed as-used identity sufficient? How may MODEL_STATE evidence satisfy that consumer? Do not infer policy from absent code checks.

questions.recipient: NOAA CoastWatch chlorophyll product authority (not contacted; not NOAA-current inquiry)
questions.question: For noaacwNPPVIIRSchlaDaily, define time relative to baseline_bounds: exact UTC start/end and endpoint convention, contribution window versus pixel acquisition, and immutable product/version rule that permits reconstruction. Resolve L3 title versus L2 processing_level; do not substitute L2 filename timing.

For nesdisVHNnoaaSNPPnoaa20NRTchlaGapfilledDaily, define exact target support/coordinate anchor and bind each deployment/revision to the documented target+previous29day operational procedure (or identify changes), including climatology vintage and delayed/revised input handling. Which immutable metadata identifies this configuration and input lineage?
